semantics.true: The user explicitly requires the sunscreen to withstand water exposure or heavy perspiration, or explicitly states an aquatic/high-sweat use case that makes water resistance part of the requested product requirement.
semantics.false: The user explicitly states that water resistance is not required. This is a user requirement state only and says nothing about whether any product is waterproof.
semantics.null: No governed water-resistance need is available from the query. Missing or ambiguous intent remains unknown.
